fact: The second evaluation report states the PNN stood at 58% realisation at 31 December 2024 (40 of 69 projects started), that financing is insufficient, and that the World Bank USD 400 million and AFD EUR 100 million Digital Transformation Project (2025-2030) will carry about twenty PNN projects.
title: 2ème Rapport d'évaluation de la mise en oeuvre du Plan National du Numérique 2023-2024
publisher: Agence pour le Développement du Numérique (ADN)
